description: Image Description: The image displays a close-up of a sandwich cut in half, presented on a light pink plate. The sandwich is made with a long, crusty roll that appears to be lightly toasted, with a golden-brown exterior and a soft, porous interior. Inside the sandwich, there are multiple layers of ingredients including thinly sliced deli meats such as ham and possibly roast beef or turkey, fresh green lettuce, slices of red tomato, and pickled vegetables like green peppers or jalapeños
